hypotheses.expect: build_inspector reds every ticket whose cursor stands at a stage before BUILDME in its own workflow path (THINKME, TICKETME, FIXME, any stage the path places ahead of BUILDME) while the cairn repo's main carries a commit whose subject names its id before the subject's first colon, that changes a build path (outside press_office/, proofs/ and validations/, not *.md, not a component's history.json or state.json, not .artifact-journal.jsonl), and that is newer than the ticket's latest forward BUILDME crossing (or the ticket never crossed BUILDME). The red names the ticket, its cursor and the commits. A ticket at or past BUILDME, one named only after the colon, one whose only naming commits are doc commits or its red-first proof (proof, seal, journals), or one whose naming code commits all predate its latest forward BUILDME crossing, is not red.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) a ticket whose cursor stands before BUILDME in its path (TICKETME or FIXME) and whose id is named by a code commit newer than its latest forward BUILDME crossing is reported, with that commit's sha and the cursor; (2) a ticket whose only naming commit changes press_office/ or a .md file, a ticket named only after the subject's first colon, a ticket at or past BUILDME with a code commit, and a TICKETME ticket named by no commit are each NOT reported, and a FIXME ticket whose naming code commits all predate its latest forward BUILDME crossing is NOT reported, and a TICKETME ticket whose only naming commit is its red-first proof (proofs/, validations/, history.json, state.json, .artifact-journal.jsonl) is NOT reported
